A '''gas refill valve''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] component. It allowed the blaster to be refilled with a number of different [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gases]]. The gas refill valve's nozzle came in a number of different sizes and styles to accommodate the varied number of blaster designs.<ref name="GFT" /> The gas refill valve allowed the [[Gas/Legends|gas]] to enter the blaster and be stored in the internal [[gas chamber]]. Gas refill valves were typically located at the back of the blaster, such as on the [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]]<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref> and the [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
